d: M-8080D 8x8 Digital Matrix Mixer is dedicated music, discussion, paging and zone management solutions for Commercial Audio applications.

specs.label: Inputs
specs.value: AUDIO INPUT: 1-8: -48 to 0dBv, 6.8 kΩ, electronic balanced, removable terminal block (3 pins x8)

specs.label: Outputs
specs.value: AUDIO OUTPUT: 1-8: 0dBv, 1.8kΩ, Maximum output 20 dBu(7.75V), electronic balanced, removable terminal block (3 pins x 8)

specs.label: Signal processing
specs.value: Equalizer / Filter; Gate; Compressor; Ducker; Feedback Compression (FBC); Auto Mixer; Delay

specs.label: Equalizer / Filter
specs.value: 5 band EQ (LPF and HPF) for IN and 8 band EQ (LPF and HPF) for OUT; Parametic Equalizer: 19.7 - 20160 HZ, range: ±18 dB, Q: 0.4 - 128, Type: peak/low/high

specs.label: Compressor
specs.value: Threshold: -30 to +20 dB in 1 dB steps; Attack: 10 -150 ms; Release: 10 ms - 1 s
